mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM block_file bf JOIN file f ON f.file_id = bf.file_id JOIN file_version fv ON fv.file_id = f.file_id WHERE bf.block_id = #{blockId} AND f.name = #{name} AND f.deleted_at IS NULL AND fv.upload_status = 'COMPLETED' AND fv.deleted_at IS NULL )
SELECT bf.block_id FROM block_file bf WHERE bf.file_id = #{fileId} LIMIT 1
SELECT b.step_id FROM block_file bf JOIN block b ON b.block_id = bf.block_id WHERE bf.file_id = #{fileId} LIMIT 1

SELECT file_version_id AS fileVersionId, version_no AS versionNo, original_file_name AS originalFileName, extension AS extension, size_bytes AS sizeBytes, page_count AS pageCount, comment AS comment, uploader_name AS uploaderName, uploader_department AS uploaderDepartment, uploader_position AS uploaderPosition, completed_at AS completedAt FROM file_version WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND upload_status = 'COMPLETED' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY version_no DESC
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version_no), 0) FROM file_version WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND upload_status = 'COMPLETED' AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT f.file_id AS fileId, f.name AS name, lv.file_version_id AS latestVersionId, lv.version_no AS latestVersionNo, vc.cnt AS versionCount, lv.original_file_name AS originalFileName, lv.extension AS extension, lv.size_bytes AS sizeBytes, lv.uploader_name AS uploaderName, lv.uploader_department AS uploaderDepartment, lv.uploader_position AS uploaderPosition, lv.completed_at AS updatedAt, f.deleted_at AS deletedAt FROM block_file bf JOIN file f ON f.file_id = bf.file_id JOIN ( -- 블록에 연결된 문서로 먼저 좁힌 뒤 집계한다 — file_version 전체를 스캔하지 않도록. SELECT fv.file_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt, MAX(fv.version_no) AS mx FROM file_version fv JOIN block_file bfi ON bfi.file_id = fv.file_id AND bfi.block_id = #{blockId} WHERE fv.upload_status = 'COMPLETED' AND fv.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY fv.file_id ) vc ON vc.file_id = f.file_id JOIN file_version lv ON lv.file_id = f.file_id AND lv.version_no = vc.mx AND lv.upload_status = 'COMPLETED' AND lv.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE bf.block_id = #{blockId} AND ( (#{deleted} = FALSE AND f.deleted_at IS NULL) OR (#{deleted} = TRUE AND f.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) ) ORDER BY bf.linked_at ASC, f.file_id ASC

SELECT f.file_id AS fileId, f.name AS name, fv.file_version_id AS fileVersionId, fv.version_no AS versionNo, fv.original_file_name AS originalFileName, fv.extension AS extension, fv.size_bytes AS sizeBytes, fv.page_count AS pageCount, fv.completed_at AS completedAt, COALESCE(fi.index_status, 'PENDING') AS indexStatus FROM file f JOIN file_version fv ON fv.file_id = f.file_id AND fv.upload_status = 'COMPLETED' AND fv.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN file_index fi ON fi.file_version_id = fv.file_version_id AND fi.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE f.project_id = #{projectId} AND f.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY f.file_id ASC, fv.version_no DESC

SELECT b.step_id AS stepId, s.name AS stepName, CASE WHEN b.deleted_at IS NULL THEN b.block_id END AS blockId, CASE WHEN b.deleted_at IS NULL THEN b.title END AS blockTitle, (b.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AS blockDeleted, f.file_id AS fileId, f.name AS name, lv.file_version_id AS latestVersionId, lv.version_no AS latestVersionNo, vc.cnt AS versionCount, lv.original_file_name AS originalFileName, lv.extension AS extension, lv.size_bytes AS sizeBytes, lv.uploader_name AS uploaderName, lv.uploader_department AS uploaderDepartment, lv.uploader_position AS uploaderPosition, lv.completed_at AS updatedAt FROM file f JOIN block_file bf ON bf.file_id = f.file_id JOIN block b ON b.block_id = bf.block_id JOIN step s ON s.step_id = b.step_id JOIN ( -- 프로젝트 문서로 먼저 좁힌 뒤 집계한다 — file_version 전체를 스캔하지 않도록. SELECT fv.file_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt, MAX(fv.version_no) AS mx FROM file_version fv JOIN file fj ON fj.file_id = fv.file_id AND fj.project_id = #{projectId} WHERE fv.upload_status = 'COMPLETED' AND fv.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY fv.file_id ) vc ON vc.file_id = f.file_id JOIN file_version lv ON lv.file_id = f.file_id AND lv.version_no = vc.mx AND lv.upload_status = 'COMPLETED' AND lv.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE f.project_id = #{projectId} AND f.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY b.step_id ASC, b.block_id ASC, bf.linked_at ASC, f.file_id ASC

SELECT b.step_id AS stepId, s.name AS stepName, CASE WHEN b.deleted_at IS NULL THEN b.block_id END AS blockId, CASE WHEN b.deleted_at IS NULL THEN b.title END AS blockTitle, (b.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AS blockDeleted, f.file_id AS fileId, f.name AS name, vc.cnt AS versionCount, lv.original_file_name AS originalFileName, lv.extension AS extension, lv.size_bytes AS sizeBytes, f.deleted_at AS deletedAt FROM file f JOIN block_file bf ON bf.file_id = f.file_id JOIN block b ON b.block_id = bf.block_id JOIN step s ON s.step_id = b.step_id JOIN ( SELECT fv.file_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt, MAX(fv.version_no) AS mx FROM file_version fv JOIN file fj ON fj.file_id = fv.file_id AND fj.project_id = #{projectId} WHERE fv.upload_status = 'COMPLETED' AND fv.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY fv.file_id ) vc ON vc.file_id = f.file_id JOIN file_version lv ON lv.file_id = f.file_id AND lv.version_no = vc.mx AND lv.upload_status = 'COMPLETED' AND lv.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE f.project_id = #{projectId} AND f.deleted_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY f.deleted_at DESC, f.file_id ASC
